body:
Founder real-time: 'continue working on parena editor' (continuation).

The next real keys a single-line edit loop needs once Left/Right cursor movement existed: Home/End jump the cursor to the start/end of the line (always succeeds); Delete removes the character AHEAD of the cursor (Backspace covers the one behind), a real, honest OutOfRange when nothing is ahead. runtime/parena_runtime.h gained the real SDLK_HOME/SDLK_END/SDLK_DELETE getters, sdl2.prn wraps them, editor/buffer.prn gained move-cursor-home/move-cursor-end/delete-forward-at-cursor, wired into examples/editor_main.c's real event loop.

Verified with real tests: Home jumps to 0, forward-delete from there removes the real correct character, End jumps to the real end, forward-delete there correctly reports OutOfRange (not a crash or silent no-op). Clean under -Werror and ASan+UBSan. Zero regression in the full suite + make editor-demo-smoke.

Commit: 688cf3b.

⚓ ☃
title: Real Home/End keys + forward-delete wired into the PARENA editor
